{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in the two variables of interest
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Verify the number of rows remaining
print(f'Rows after dropping missing values: {len(penguins_clean)}')

# Compute Pearson correlation
correlation = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])

# Print the result
print(f'Pearson correlation between flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g: {correlation:.4f}')"}
